answer: Hardware attestation resists Sybil attacks by having each agent bind its key to a unique chip ID in a trusted enclave and send verifiers a vendor-signed quote over a fresh nonce. Because keys stay locked in physical silicon, attackers cannot sprout a lotus of clones from one ember of virtual compute and must provision a scarce opal of dedicated hardware per identity. However, admission trusts manufacturer root certificates and remains vulnerable to side-channel extraction.
